symptom: Self-maintenance structured QA accepted source-governance evidence whose command only printed help, reduced --top below 10, or redirected --repo-root to another tree, so a reported exit code 0 could satisfy the mandatory governance gate without auditing the repository.
root_cause: matches_source_governance_command validated only the Python executable and source_governance.py path; it did not bind the command arguments to the canonical --top 10 contract before _reported_check_passed trusted the reported status and exit code.
